title: Reasons to stay natural: your body is an incredible machine
summary: NH argues for staying natural because exogenous hormones are a recent, poorly understood intrusion into a body shaped over millennia, individual risk is unknowable, and young men jumping on TRT lack patience. He believes training and muscle gain raise natural testosterone over time.
claims: Exogenous hormones have existed for less than a century, so their effects on a body shaped by ancestral DNA are poorly understood
Only case studies exist on PED users; when you don't hold all the cards it's best not to play
Individual response is unknowable: some users have clean bloodwork while others lose their liver within six months
TRT is the new fake natty trend; young men jump on it out of impatience
Comparing yourself to enhanced athletes injecting several times human hormone levels is like comparing yourself to a tiger
Your body won't betray you as long as you don't betray it; PEDs tell your body to stop producing
Long-term users end up on TRT because their natural production is gone, and their muscle melts when they come off
Pro bodybuilding is unrelatable because everyone knows what it takes; there's space for natural bodybuilding to show what work and patience can do
Healthy people blaming bad genetics after two years of training are ungrateful and impatient: all the ingredients, too lazy to bake the cake
Train, eat and rest well before concluding your testosterone is low; the body adapts to the load
As naturals build muscle their testosterone production rises; muscle creation improves the hormonal environment
He has old blood tests and believes his testosterone has kept rising slowly
The body prefers fat over muscle because fat stores more energy for famine, but that's no excuse to stay on the couch
